guard: stopForSignal and managerStatusData consume the shipped supervisor lookup; a released-unproven binding stays live and selects preserve-native cleanup
why: PRODUCTION CALLER: caught SIGINT/SIGTERM -> Manager.stopForSignal and the served status command -> managerStatusData both call nativeLifecycleBindings.
The suite reaches nativeLifecycleLookupForSupervisor and the auth closed query. Injected Manager.nativeLifecycleBindings stubs do not grade this.
A released-unproven row must appear in status liveBindingIds and must select stopPreservingNative, not stop.

mutations.name: signal shutdown always takes the legacy destructive path
mutations.find:
if (native.bindings.length > 0) await this.stopPreservingNative();
    else await this.stop();
mutations.expectRed: PRODUCTION CALLER stopForSignal: released-unproven selects preserve-native cleanup
mutations.cell: PRODUCTION CALLER stopForSignal: released-unproven selects preserve-native cleanup

mutations.name: status reports zero live bindings on a known lookup
mutations.find: ? { status: "known", liveBindings: native.bindings.length, liveBindingIds: native.bindings.map((binding) => binding.bindingId) }
mutations.expectRed: PRODUCTION CALLER managerStatusData: released-unproven is a live binding
mutations.cell: PRODUCTION CALLER managerStatusData: released-unproven is a live binding
